name: Banzami SDK Contract
note: EXPECTED SDK contract: what official Banzami SDKs are expected to handle for integrators. Two packages are published, each with a clean-room registry install on record: @banzami/sdk on npm (server-side, secret key) and banzami_client on pub.dev (client-side, publishable key only). The Python and PHP packages are not published — source only, until official publication — and have no install command. The internal Flutter application framework (banzami_flutter) is never published. The SDK-style examples under /developers/examples/sdk-preview/ describe intended ergonomics only; they are not installation instructions. Sandbox/Preview documentation scope only; not a Production contract; no production key issuance; no live rails.
